features.user_visible_behavior: The application extracts title, artist when available, package name and playback state.
verification: Use `MediaSessionManager` / `MediaController` as the primary metadata source.
Play a track in a supported media application.
Verify title extraction.
Verify artist extraction when available.
Verify package name extraction.
Verify `PLAYING` state.
Pause the track and verify `PAUSED`.
Resume the track and verify `PLAYING`.
Use `Notification.extras` as fallback when MediaSession metadata is unavailable.
Do not invent missing metadata.
features.notes: MediaSession is the primary source. Notification extras are fallback data.

features.title: Deduplicate Repeated Music Events
features.user_visible_behavior: Repeated observations of the same track and state do not create duplicate records.
verification: Keep one song playing for at least 60 seconds.
Verify only one `PLAYING` event is persisted.
Send repeated identical `PLAYING` observations and verify they are ignored.
Pause the song and verify exactly one `PAUSED` event.
Send repeated `PAUSED` observations and verify they are ignored.
Resume the song and verify exactly one new `PLAYING` event.
Change tracks and verify exactly one new event.
Change the source package and verify it is treated as a new event.
Compare title + artist + packageName + playbackState against the last persisted event.
features.notes: Same song + same state = ignore. Same song + different state = save. Different song or package = save.
